hero.title: MONITORING, EVALUATION, RESEARCH, LEARNING, AND ADAPTATION (MERLA)

coreOfferings.title: Our Core Offerings
coreOfferings.subtitle: At IP3 Consulting, we deliver tailored MERLA solutions to empower effective decision-making, enhance performance, and drive systemic change. Combining social science expertise, digital innovation, and adaptive learning, we help organizations achieve measurable impact across diverse sectors.

tabs.name: Impact Evaluation
tabs.title: Impact Evaluation
tabs.tagline: Globally Benchmarked Methodologies for Informed Decision-Making
tabs.edge: Data-driven impact assessment frameworks, Globally benchmarked evaluation methodologies, Gender-inclusive impact analysis.
points: Conducting rigorous outcome and impact evaluations leveraging quasi-experimental and counterfactual methodologies to measure effectiveness and causal attribution.
Applying mixed method frameworks integrating qualitative insights with quantitative techniques for holistic impact assessments.
Ensuring high quality, globally benchmarked data collection, adhering to World Bank, OECD-DAC criteria, Randomized methodologies, and DFID's best practices.

tabs.name: Monitoring & Results
tabs.title: Monitoring & Results Measurement
tabs.tagline: Harnessing Real-Time Insights for Adaptive Program Management
tabs.edge: Real-time monitoring systems, Geospatial data integration, Adaptive management dashboards.
points: Designing & Deploying Secure, Scalable Data Systems – Developing context-specific, high-integrity data ecosystems that enhance decision-making, transparency, and accountability.
Real Time Monitoring & Predictive Analytics – Leveraging interactive dashboards, AI-powered analytics, and geospatial tools for real-time program tracking and impact assessment.
Capacity Building & Institutional Strengthening – Supporting national governments and development organizations in building resilient, high-quality monitoring frameworks.

tabs.name: Fit-for-Purpose Evaluation
tabs.title: Fit-for-Purpose Evaluation
tabs.tagline: Tailored, Adaptive, and Data-Driven Evaluation for Complex Challenges
tabs.edge: Mixed method evaluation design, Context-specific MEL frameworks, Adaptive evaluation for specific programs.
points: Bespoke Mixed Method Evaluation Design – Crafting customized evaluation frameworks that integrate advanced quantitative analytics with qualitative methodologies for context specific insights.
Sector-Specific Evaluation & Local Adaptation – Developing targeted evaluation approaches for key sectors, including climate resilience, global health, education, and sustainable development.
Operational & Adaptive Research – Conducting real-time operational research to identify bottlenecks, enhance resource efficiency, and optimize implementation strategies.

tabs.name: Digital Monitoring Solutions
tabs.title: Digital Monitoring Solutions
tabs.tagline: Harnessing AI, Automation, and Digital Transformation
tabs.edge: Real-time monitoring systems, Geospatial data integration, Adaptive management dashboards.
points: AI-Powered Data Analytics & Predictive Modeling – Leveraging machine learning and AI-driven automation to enhance data accuracy and optimize trend forecasting.
Scalable Digital Platforms & Visualization Dashboards – Deploying cost-effective, interactive data ecosystems that integrate custom analytics and real-time performance tracking.
IoT & ICT Integration for Seamless Data Collection – Utilizing Internet of Things (IoT) devices and digital reporting tools to ensure enhanced data integrity.

tabs.name: Action Research
tabs.title: Action Research & Collaboration
tabs.edge: Mixed method evaluation design, Context-specific MEL frameworks, Adaptive evaluation.
points: Stakeholder-Led Knowledge Co-Creation - Implementing participatory action research models that engage local communities to generate data-driven solutions.
Adaptive Learning & Iterative Strategy Refinement – Facilitating "Pause and Reflect" workshops, real-time program adaptation, and continuous learning cycles.
Multi-Level Knowledge Exchange for Scalable Solutions – Aligning local insights with global development frameworks through cross-sectoral collaboration.

merlaProjects.title: MERLA Projects
merlaProjects.description: Interactive physical card deck fan — hover cards to pull them from the deck, or use controls/touch to navigate through our major monitoring and evaluation engagements.

items.title: Health Access & Linkage for Workers [HALOW+] (2019)
items.description: IP3 Consulting played a key role in the HALOW+ Program, a multi-stakeholder initiative led by Marks & Spencer, GSK, PwC-UK, and Care International to improve health service markets and worker well-being in RMG sector.

items.title: Transforming Urban Sanitation with Data-Driven M&E (2020)
items.description: IP3 Consulting designed the Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) and Results Framework for the Dhaka Sewerage Improvement Project (DSIP), enhancing sewerage networks, wastewater treatment, and non-network sanitation services.

items.title: Accelerating Clean Energy Access Through Results-Based Financing (2018)
items.description: IP3 Consulting led the design and implementation of a results-based financing strategy for the Global Lighting & Energy Access Partnership (Global LEAP), fostering commercial markets for off-grid solar solutions.

cta.title: Partner with Us for Adaptive MERLA Systems
paragraphs: Turn data into continuous improvement and measurable outcomes. At IP3 Consulting, we build real-time monitoring platforms, independent evaluations, and adaptive learning architectures for national programs.
Together, we ensure accountability, transparency, and sustained impact.
